grow.heading: Grow connection
grow.description: Connect your Grow account so sales are recorded here automatically the moment a customer pays.
grow.howTo: Add a connection below, copy its unique webhook URL, and ask Grow support to enable both the relevant transaction webhook and "Invoice creation" for it — using that exact same URL for both. Without "Invoice creation," sales are still recorded automatically, but the customer document won't be attached automatically.
grow.verificationNote: Grow does not provide a webhook test environment, so this connection can only be verified by a real transaction — it stays "waiting for first transaction" until then, and is never described as active before that happens. Automatic document linking (Invoice creation) is only considered active once a real invoice webhook has actually been received.
grow.refundsNote: Grow does not currently send refund or cancellation updates through this connection — record those manually on the sale.
grow.csvFallbackNote: If a transaction is ever missed, use CSV import below to add it after the fact.
grow.emptyState: Grow is not connected yet. Set it up to receive sales automatically.
grow.ownerOnlyNote: Only the business owner can add or manage Grow connections.
grow.rotateUrlWarning: This immediately creates a new webhook URL and disables the current one. Any transaction Grow sends to the old URL after this point will be rejected — update your Grow account with the new URL right away.
grow.deleteWarning: This permanently deletes "{{name}}" and its webhook URL. Transactions already recorded are not affected, but new transactions from Grow will stop being received.

cardcom.heading: Cardcom connection
cardcom.description: Connect a Cardcom terminal so sales are recorded here automatically once each payment is verified with Cardcom.
cardcom.howTo: Add a connection below for each terminal, copy its unique webhook URL, and paste it into that terminal's webhook settings in your Cardcom account.
cardcom.declinedNote: Cardcom can report declined payments through this connection — they are recorded as failed, never as revenue. Enable decline notifications for this terminal in your Cardcom dashboard if you want them to appear here.
cardcom.refundsNote: Refunds and cancellations are not automatically received through this connection — record those manually on the sale.
cardcom.csvFallbackNote: If a transaction is ever missed, use CSV import below to add it after the fact.
cardcom.emptyState: Cardcom is not connected yet. Set it up to receive sales automatically.
cardcom.ownerOnlyNote: Only the business owner can add or manage Cardcom connections.
cardcom.credentialsNote: Credentials are encrypted and used only to verify payments directly with Cardcom. They are never shown again after the connection is created.
cardcom.rotateUrlWarning: This immediately creates a new webhook URL and disables the current one. Any transaction Cardcom sends to the old URL after this point will be rejected — update this terminal's webhook settings in Cardcom with the new URL right away.
cardcom.deleteWarning: This permanently deletes "{{name}}" and its webhook URL and credentials. Transactions already recorded are not affected, but new transactions from Cardcom will stop being received.
